situation: A night-shift worker sits alone at a wooden table in an empty breakroom at dawn, staring blankly down at his hands.
subject: the exhaustion
brief: A middle-aged man sits at a scarred wooden table with his shoulders rounded heavily inward, resting his forehead against the heel of one heavy hand. An untouched paper cup of coffee sits beside him under the pale, flat light of a single fluorescent ceiling tube. The surrounding walls are bare and dark, throwing all weight onto his drooping posture and the deep, dark smudges beneath his eyes.
